assumptions.choice: base_price is set to 50.0 and main_shares is set to 1000
assumptions.reason: Allows the activation threshold (3 * base_price = 150.0) to be reached during the 2020-2025 AAPL dataset while preserving exact specification scaling logic.

assumptions.choice: price_stop is calculated as executed_entry_price + 1 * ATR(14) recorded at entry fill time
assumptions.reason: The specification defines price_stop = entry + 1*ATR(14), which fixes the stop price based on entry fill price and entry volatility level.

assumptions.choice: Threshold index k is calculated as floor((Close / base_price - 1) / 0.10) for k >= 1
assumptions.reason: Represents incremental 10% price thresholds above base_price. A threshold breach occurs when a new integer level k > max_k_breached is first reached.

assumptions.choice: Expiration is measured by counting daily bars elapsed since position fill (len(self) - entry_bar >= term)
assumptions.reason: Aligns with the specification defining expiration as a 90 or 180 daily-bar timer.
